steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Muslims must pray five times a day (salah) — at dawn (Fajr), midday (Zuhr), afternoon (Asr), evening (Maghrib) and night (Isha). This is the second Pillar of Islam and the most frequent daily religious practice. | RS Exam Tips — Salah: Prayer: 1. For Salah: Prayer questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of Salah: Prayer to its real-world impact on believers and society | UK Context: In the UK, many mosques organise their five daily prayers around work and school schedules.
